label: Guard: login provider
info:
Login and consent provider of the guard (the authorization server is Ory Hydra).

Wallet login: the authorization server sends the browser to /guard/login; the page shows the presentation request of the credential verifier (QR code, same-device link, web wallets); /guard/login/status checks the stored presentation, the status list and the login policy, then accepts the login. /guard/consent puts the verified claims into the tokens; /guard/logout ends the session. Configuration: GUARD_* environment variables, see services/guard/README.md.
